_frame_plan_note: Target 32.0s matching the series' established pacing (see road-paint-manifest.json). Per-beat frame windows below are this episode's own estimate, proportional to each narration beat's approximate speaking length; the real captured narration only has to sum to <=32.0s total (curious_mechanics_audio.py's slack mechanism), it does not have to match these per-shot boundaries exactly.

shots.visual_proof: Wide 3/4 elevated angle on a straight barrier run receding into the distance, slow push-in -- the only wide establishing shot in the episode
shots.narration_en: This low concrete wall along the highway is called a Jersey barrier.

shots.visual_proof: Low behind-car chase angle: a car approaches a flat-faced wall at a shallow angle and stops dead, nose dipping down on impact -- the only flat-wall shot, and the only low chase-cam shot used for the 'before' half of the comparison
shots.narration_en: Hit a flat wall at an angle, and the car just stops dead.

shots.visual_proof: Macro, orthogonal side-on cutaway of the barrier's profile with the camera orbiting ~30 degrees to reveal the sloped wedge shape in silhouette -- no car in frame, the only profile/cutaway shot
shots.narration_en: This barrier's face isn't flat. It's angled, like a ramp.

shots.visual_proof: Extreme macro at wheel height, tight on the car's front tire riding up the sloped face -- the only extreme close-up shot and the only one with the wheel (not the whole car) as the subject
shots.narration_en: A wheel that hits it climbs the slope instead of digging in.

shots.visual_proof: Same low chase angle and approach geometry as flat_wall_fail, but against the sloped barrier: the car rides up and redirects, continuing forward roughly parallel to the barrier instead of stopping dead -- a deliberate mirrored pair with flat_wall_fail so the before/after comparison is literally on screen, same device as road-paint's with/without-beads comparison shot
shots.narration_en: That lifts the car just enough to steer it back into its lane.

shots.visual_proof: High overhead angle looking down the barrier line at dusk, slow lateral pan only -- the only overhead shot and the only pure-pan camera move in the episode
shots.narration_en: One curve in a concrete wall keeps cars from becoming projectiles.
